name: travel-company-lead-extractor
description: Travel Company Lead Extractor - Search travel companies and extract business emails

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && timeout /t 5 /nobreak >nul 2>&1 & npm run db:push
